name: Abiram
overview: Abiram, son of Hiel, is known in Scripture as one of the leaders who, along with Dathan and Korah, rebelled against the divinely appointed leadership of Moses and Aaron. This conspiracy against the LORD resulted in a dramatic judgment where the earth opened and swallowed them, their households, and possessions, serving as a sobering sign to all Israel of God's righteous authority. The record of Abiram's lineage and his father's involvement in rebuilding Jericho further situates him within Israel's history and God's unfolding plan.
